scripts.clean: if exist dist rd /s /q dist && if exist out rd /s /q out
scripts.copyToDist: mkdir dist 2>nul && copy /y src\task.json dist\ && copy /y src\package*.json dist\
scripts.compile: npm run copyToDist && tsc && cd dist && npm ci --production
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file configs/release.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file configs/dev.json --output-path out
scripts.publish: npm run build && tfx extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file configs/release.json --output-path out
scripts.publish:dev: npm run build && tfx extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file configs/dev.json --output-path out
